name: Mycobiome targeted amplicon sequencing benchmark
description: Assesses and optimizes targeted amplicon sequencing protocols for detecting and characterizing fungal communities in respiratory specimens, reporting sensitivity and reproducibility.
evaluation_method: sensitivity and reproducibility (e.g., true positive rate, precision, repeatability metrics)
general_score_metric: sensitivity (true positive rate) and reproducibility metrics
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark used by clinical mycology and microbiome research groups for protocol evaluation and optimization; limited use outside the field.
notes: Wet-lab benchmarking subject to contamination risk, sample variability, platform-specific biases, small cohort sizes, and non-LLM (laboratory/protocol) focus; limits direct comparability across studies.
